verdicts.rationale: The arrays a and ia are allocated without initialization at L878, and no intervening assignment or call receiving them defines their elements before the master copies them at L910-L911. scattertest initializes its inputs at L38-L45 only after these reads (calls at L913 and L917-L918); the later overwrite prevents propagation into the scatter checks but does not neutralize the preceding undefined reads.

evidence_span.quote:
if (xmaster) then
  aa(1:ma,1:na) = a
  iaa(1:ma,1:na) = ia
endif
call scattertest(a,ia,b,ib)
